metadata.title: आदिवासी और भारत निर्माण | Adivasi Freedom Fighters & Misrepresented History | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: In this exclusive interview, Dr Jeetendra Meena, author of a new book on the role of tribal freedom fighters in shaping India, speaks to Main Bhi Bharat about the forgotten chapters of our history. Dr Meena asserts that historians have not been fully honest in documenting the struggles and sacrifices of tribal heroes. He warns that in today’s times, right-wing organisations are attempting to misrepresent and appropriate these leaders, making it crucial to set the historical record straight. Watch this thought-provoking conversation to understand the significance of tribal contributions to India's freedom struggle and why their legacy must be preserved authentically.
